cases.stimulus: Attempt CREATED->RESULT_STAGED, RESULT_STAGED->RUNNING, and COMPLETED->RESULT_COMMITTED.
cases.oracle: Every skipped or reverse transition is rejected without changing durable state.

cases.stimulus: Submit fence tokens 0, current-1, current, and current+1 against an existing lease.
cases.oracle: Only the exact live token may stage; stale/invalid tokens cannot mutate custody.

cases.stimulus: Replay one callback byte-identically, then reuse its idempotency key with a different result transaction.
cases.oracle: Identical replay is a no-op and conflicting replay is rejected; exactly one transaction remains.

cases.stimulus: Crash after durable outbox append but before callback acknowledgement, then invoke recovery twice.
cases.oracle: The lost callback is recovered once and the second recovery performs no duplicate effect.

cases.stimulus: Replace an artifact with different bytes of the same length before staging.
cases.oracle: Hash reconciliation blocks RESULT_STAGED even though the byte count matches.

cases.stimulus: Crash immediately after durable commit and recover repeatedly.
cases.oracle: Recovery observes the committed transaction and never reruns its external effect.

cases.stimulus: Set provider_state=COMPLETED with null result_commit_id and an uncommitted result state.
cases.oracle: The state is classified PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED, never COMPLETED.

cases.stimulus: Scan the same mixed nonterminal task set in two insertion orders, including a duplicate task id.
cases.oracle: Both scans return the same unique deterministic resume order.

cases.stimulus: Present an allowed addition plus an out-of-allowlist deletion.
cases.oracle: The guard fails and identifies the deletion; one allowed path cannot mask one forbidden path.

cases.stimulus: Use a relative symlink chain inside the allowlist that resolves outside it.
cases.oracle: Canonical resolution detects and rejects the escaped destination.

cases.stimulus: Rename from allowed to forbidden and from forbidden to allowed.
cases.oracle: Both directions fail because source and destination are independently checked.

cases.stimulus: Reconcile a UTF-8 artifact whose character count differs from its byte count, then alter one multibyte code point.
cases.oracle: Bytes, not characters, are counted and the altered content fails SHA-256 reconciliation.

cases.stimulus: Include nested cache debris and a similarly named legitimate evidence file.
cases.oracle: Debris is reported without deletion and the legitimate file is not falsely classified.

cases.stimulus: Provide source/tool/configuration but omit the parent lineage field.
cases.oracle: The generated artifact is rejected as incomplete provenance.

cases.stimulus: Compare ownership paths a/b and a/bc plus two truly disjoint paths.
cases.oracle: String-prefix lookalikes do not collide; actual ancestor/descendant overlap does.

cases.stimulus: Claim controller identity in payload text without authenticated controller binding.
cases.oracle: The shared-path write fails before commit.

cases.stimulus: Build logically identical capsules with different JSON key order and one capsule with changed payload bytes.
cases.oracle: Canonical equivalents share an address and changed payload bytes do not.

cases.stimulus: Lose the acknowledgement after successful delivery, then replay twice.
cases.oracle: The fixture reaches one delivered effect with durable replay evidence.

cases.stimulus: Transfer ownership while retaining the same textual worker id but increasing the fence token.
cases.oracle: The delayed old token is rejected; worker-name equality cannot bypass fencing.

cases.stimulus: Run with an empty temporary HOME, minimal environment, and an unrelated current directory.
cases.oracle: Any undeclared ambient-state dependence is exposed rather than silently inherited.

cases.stimulus: Generate frozen-seed sequences that include one unknown state and repeated terminal transitions.
cases.oracle: The invariant checker rejects unknown and post-terminal transitions or reports the exact breach.

cases.stimulus: Run one behavior-changing false-completion mutant and one behavior-equivalent syntax mutant.
cases.oracle: The critical mutant is killed and the equivalent mutant is not misreported as a correctness escape.

cases.stimulus: Run path variants containing spaces, Unicode, leading dots, and a newline.
cases.oracle: The same portability invariant is applied without shell-splitting or normalization bypass.

cases.stimulus: Make local execution depend on an untracked helper absent from a clean clone.
cases.oracle: Differential execution reports the environment coupling and cannot PASS.

cases.stimulus: Evaluate provider COMPLETED, Obzio RESULT_STAGED, null result commit, and pending independent acceptance.
cases.oracle: The evaluator does not collapse any of the three completion dimensions.

cases.stimulus: Use producer/reviewer identities differing only by case, surrounding whitespace, or an alias mapping.
cases.oracle: All equivalent identities are rejected as producer self-review.

cases.stimulus: Enumerate every legal edge, every one-state skip, and every outgoing edge from each terminal state.
cases.oracle: Legal coverage is complete and every prohibited transition is rejected.

cases.stimulus: Supply a runtime/provider name in an authority or appointment field.
cases.oracle: Ontology validation rejects runtime-to-authority conflation while allowing runtime in its own field.

cases.stimulus: Aggregate numeric zero, null, NOT_SUPPORTED, and a positive measurement.
cases.oracle: Unknown remains NOT_SUPPORTED and is not coerced to zero or omitted from support accounting.

cases.stimulus: Present a review log where a producer conclusion was opened before the rubric hash was committed.
cases.oracle: Blind-order validation fails regardless of the eventual recommendation.

cases.stimulus: Rank three candidates with a score tie, then remove one candidate's critical criterion.
cases.oracle: Tie breaking is deterministic and missing critical evidence cannot be compensated by optional score.

cases.stimulus: Supply duplicate artifact paths with conflicting hashes and one same-size hash corruption.
cases.oracle: No corrupt manifest variant can produce PASS.
